title: feat(app-shell): Setup positions list shows holders and granted permission sets; whole row opens the item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWnNJDmFSk7m68Yejj9bevh)_

Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25333. This is the console half. The server half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#25369.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## What

Setup → Positions now says who holds each position and which permission sets it grants, and the whole row opens the position.

- **Two columns, both the server's.** The list reads `GET /meta/position?include=grants` through a new `listInclude` registry option. **Holders** renders the served `_holderCount`, and **Permission sets** renders the served `_grantedPermissionSets` in served order. The server computes both where the authorization resolver enforces them (objectstack#25369), and the console computes neither.
- **The same-named set is shown, marked "(by name)".** The position-name fold grants it although the definition does not list it (objectstack#24757). A tooltip says why it is there. Declared sets carry no mark.
- **A count nobody measured is "—", never 0.** That covers a served `null` and a server that predates `include=grants`.
- **The whole row opens the item** on every Setup metadata list (`openRowFromClick`). The first cell keeps its link for the keyboard, screen readers and opening in a new tab. These clicks do not open the row:
  - a click on a control in the row (the Active switch, Clone, a link);
  - a modified click;
  - a click that ends a text selection;
  - a click that reached the row through a portal (a dialog a row control opened).
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`.** `MetadataClient.list` and `listResponse` accept `include: 'grants'`.

## Tests

- `ResourceListPage.positionGrants-25333.test.tsx` (5 tests):
  - the position list asks `include: 'grants'`, and the permission-set list (control) does not;
  - counts as served, with "—" for `null` and for an absent key;
  - sets in served order, with `via: 'name'` marked and declared sets unmarked;
  - a row click opens the position with its scope kept, and (control) the Active switch and a modified click do not navigate.
- `metadata-client.listInclude-25333.test.ts` (3 tests): the URL with and without `include`, alongside `package`.
- **Ablations**, each turning exactly its test red:
  - with no control guard, the switch click navigates;
  - with no row handler, the row click does nothing;
  - with no `include`, the list asks the plain list.
- **Locally green:**
  - type-check for app-shell and data-objectstack;
  - eslint on the touched files;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` and `check:test-path-roots`;
  - vitest on `packages/data-objectstack/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` and `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`.
